{{Use American English|date=March 2026}} {{use mdy dates|date=April 2022}} {{Infobox television season | bgcolor = #95BDC7 | image = Dancing with the Stars (U.S. season 18).jpg | caption = Promotional poster, featuring former pro dancer [[Anna Trebunskaya]] | module1 = {{Infobox reality competition season | host = {{Plainlist| * [[Tom Bergeron]] * [[Erin Andrews]] }} | judges = {{Plainlist| * [[Carrie Ann Inaba]] * [[Len Goodman]] * [[Bruno Tonioli]] }} | celebrity_winner = [[Meryl Davis]] | professional_winner = [[Maksim Chmerkovskiy]] }} | num_episodes = 12 | network = [[American Broadcasting Company|ABC]] | first_aired = {{start date|2014|3|17}} | last_aired = {{end date|2014|5|20}} }} '''Season eighteen''' of ''[[Dancing with the Stars (American TV series)|Dancing with the Stars]]'' premiered on March 17, 2014, on the [[American Broadcasting Company|ABC]] network.{{cite web|url = http://abcmedianet.com/Web/dnr/dispDNR.aspx?id=pr63742|title = ABC Announces Premiere Dates for New Drama Series ''Black Box'', ''Dancing with the Stars'' and an All-new Disney•Pixar Special, ''Toy Story that Time Forgot''|publisher = ABC Medianet|date = January 17, 2014|access-date = January 18, 2014|archive-url = https://web.archive.org/web/20140126074533/http://abcmedianet.com/Web/dnr/dispDNR.aspx?id=pr63742|archive-date = January 26, 2014|url-status = live}}{{cite web|url=http://abc.go.com/shows/dancing-with-the-stars/video/VDKA0_dan3mwm8 |title='Dancing with the Stars' Cast Announcement |publisher=ABC.com |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140224013557/http://abc.go.com/shows/dancing-with-the-stars/video/VDKA0_dan3mwm8 |archive-date=2014-02-24 }} On May 20, 2014, [[Olympic Games|Olympic]] ice dancer [[Meryl Davis]] and [[Maksim Chmerkovskiy]] were crowned the champions, while snowboarder [[Amy Purdy]] and [[Derek Hough]] finished in second place, and actress [[Candace Cameron Bure]] and [[Mark Ballas]] finished in third. This season was also first to feature a new twist called "The Switch Up", which gave viewers the opportunity to vote and change up the celebrity/professional pairings for a week during the season. Each celebrity was required to perform with a new pro for one week.{{cite web|url = http://www.huffingtonpost.com/2014/03/04/dwts-season-18-lineup_n_4895870.html|title = 'Dancing With The Stars' Announces Season 18 Lineup, New Competition Twist|publisher = Huffington Post|date = March 4, 2014|access-date = March 4, 2014|archive-url = https://web.archive.org/web/20140305033834/http://www.huffingtonpost.com/2014/03/04/dwts-season-18-lineup_n_4895870.html|archive-date = March 5, 2014|url-status = live}}{{Cite web |url=http://www.hollywoodreporter.com/live-feed/dancing-stars-season-18-cast-amy-purdy-nene-leakes-685697 |title='Dancing With the Stars' Season 18: Cast Includes NeNe Leakes, Amy Purdy, Sean Avery - Hollywood Reporter |access-date=2014-03-04 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140305053758/http://www.hollywoodreporter.com/live-feed/dancing-stars-season-18-cast-amy-purdy-nene-leakes-685697 |archive-date=2014-03-05 |url-status=live }} ==Cast== ===Couples=== This season featured twelve celebrity contestants. The cast and their professional partners were revealed on March 4, 2014, on [[Good Morning America]].{{cite web|url=https://www.usatoday.com/story/life/tv/2014/03/04/dancing-with-the-stars-unveils-season-18-cast/5981855/|title='Dancing With the Stars' unveils Season 18 cast|work=[[USA Today]]|access-date=March 4, 2014|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140304193032/http://www.usatoday.com/story/life/tv/2014/03/04/dancing-with-the-stars-unveils-season-18-cast/5981855/|archive-date=March 4, 2014|url-status=live}} [[Sasha Farber]] returned to the dance troupe, while [[Witney Carson]] and [[Henry Byalikov]] were elevated to professional status, and [[Maksim Chmerkovskiy]] also returned following a two-season hiatus.
